name: Marius Sauer
source:
Serene Stretcher-Bearer

A calm and level-headed conscientious objector, whose pacifistic ideals restrict his active service to medical roles. Knowing of his boxing past, many of the men find sport in attempting to engage him - but he has yet to cave to any pugilistic provocations.

As Marius grows closer to Elfriede, the need to protect her from the horrors of the trenches begns to eclipse even his duties... and if it were ever to be thrown into conflict with his beliefs, he has no idea how he would act. This uncertainty stalks his dreams nightly.
